## What is still open

- Join Fernhill’s end-to-end Okta SSO walkthrough on staging **Thursday at 10am New York time**; Priya runs the demo, you only need to attend. The prerequisite is cleared: Maya approved and merged **#418**, which went out with Tuesday night’s staging deploy. [1][3]
- Split **#423** into separate PRs for the module move and lint fixes. Tom requested this because the 1,900-line diff obscures the substantive changes; the cleanup also includes the stabilized SAML timing tests and mypy fixes. [1][4]
- Replace the process-local SAML assertion replay cache with Redis for multi-pod deployment. The current cache still permits cross-pod replays; use tenant + assertion ID with expiry at `NotOnOrAfter` plus clock skew. [1][2]

## What you did

- Implemented SAML assertion signature verification in **#418**: per-tenant IdP certificates, signed real fixtures, rejection of unsigned/wrong-certificate/signature-wrapping assertions, and SHA-256-or-stronger algorithms only. [2]
